turns.assessment: The fault is localized to fibre span 2 on S18→S17: OSC_LOS occurred on that span, while the immediately downstream amplifier amp2 lost about 20 dB of input and all later amplifiers showed matching input/output loss. Pump currents did not change, so the amplifiers were responding to lost upstream light rather than failing. The reverse-direction span showed no change, making a bidirectional cable cut unlikely; a large unidirectional span-loss increase best fits.

proposals.rationale: A large loss on oms.S18-S17.span1 directly explains its OSC_LOS, amp2 INPUT_LOS, the approximately 19–20 dB power reductions at amp2 and every downstream amplifier, and the widespread receiver LOF/OSNR degradation. Unchanged pump currents and normal upstream amplifiers exclude an amplifier-originated failure.

The roughly 22-second episode and subsequent protection reversion could result from handling or disturbance of this span, but the sustained near-20 dB loss and OSC_LOS are stronger than the normally brief power excursion documented for this mode.
A cut would explain signal and OSC loss, but the opposite-direction fibre showed no change and the event recovered quickly; documented cuts normally affect both fibres and persist until repair.
